sketches.mechanism: A self-recursive binding denotes bottom, and bottom can inhabit any declared type because it never produces a value.
sketches.resonance: It can be promised as anything only by never arriving.

sketches.mechanism: The pin operator makes a variable in a pattern refer to its existing value; a different value raises a match error instead of rebinding.
sketches.resonance: What is held in memory refuses to be renamed into something else.

sketches.mechanism: Elimination of the empty type False has no cases, allowing a function from contradiction to any proposition.
sketches.resonance: From the impossible, every conclusion opens, but only because no witness can enter.
sketches.draft:
Definition from_false : False -> forall A : Prop, A :=
  fun f A => match f with end.
